criteria.rationale: Born November 2, 1990, the patient was 35 on the September 1, 2026 request date.
The request is for chronic weight management, and the prescribing note addresses treatment of obesity.
The latest structured BMI before the request is 39.7 kg/m², exceeding the 30 kg/m² threshold.
The patient attended the Healthy Weight program, with documented dietary changes, physical activity, and follow-up participation.
No other current GLP-1 therapy is documented. The draft Wegovy order is the treatment under review, not concurrent therapy.
Orlistat is recorded as completed, and the notes confirm it was stopped and not restarted; no other concurrent Appendix 2 medication is documented.

parsed.summary: All six modeled criteria are met. The patient is an adult requesting Wegovy for chronic weight management, has a qualifying BMI and documented Healthy Weight program participation, and has no documented concurrent GLP-1 or other PA weight-loss medication.
